title: Add native contact sheet generator for image mining and LoRA review
operator_request: CKC/Ingest should create flexible contact sheets with DPI, rows, columns, and export settings for visually inspecting mined images.

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Build contact sheets as native export artifacts tied to Ingest review sets and CKC albums.

scope.summary: Generate contact sheets from Ingest/CKC image sets with controlled layout and export receipts.
base_scope: Select images from an ingest review set, CKC album, or character media set.
Configure DPI, rows, columns, thumbnail fit, labels, and output path.
Generate/export contact sheet artifacts with lineage metadata.
Make the preview and export controls Argus-inspectable.
Update internal UserManual with contact sheet workflow.
acceptance_criteria: A contact sheet can be generated from a selected image set.
Rows, columns, and DPI affect output layout.
Export produces a receipt linking back to source image IDs.
Argus can inspect and steer the contact sheet controls.
verification: Image/layout tests for contact sheet generation.
Native UI tests for controls and preview.

validation_v1.validated_by: INTEGRATION_VALIDATOR (acting as per-MT WP Validator per Operator directive)
validation_v1.method: Committed-source review (git base 6bb8cfb4..HEAD) + WP_VALIDATOR mechanical gates (boundary/hygiene/scope) + Spec-Realism Gate SR1/SR2/SR3, across 14 read-only sub-agents that each read Codex v1.4 + WP_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL. Adjudicated against independently-verified git ground truth. Fresh runtime re-execution was ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED_HOST_OOM at validation time (backend later recompiled clean after Operator freed memory).
validation_v1.basis: Backend emits real bytes (SR1 clean) but no committed test exercises the ArtifactStore/PG path.
validation_v1.fail_report: MT-018 is committed (ff2d19cb) and generate/export_contact_sheet build real SVG + sha256 receipt bytes and persist via write_file_artifact (real artifact:// refs) — so SR1 is clean. But the only committed backend test is the pure-function generator (no store, no PG) and the frontend 'backend export' test uses a mock HTTP server returning canned artifact:// refs. Acceptance criterion #3 (persisted receipt linking to source image IDs) is therefore proven mock-only where a managed resource is required -> SR2 gap.
validation_v1.remediation_plan: 1) Add a committed managed-PG integration test (e.g. in atelier_core_data_tests.rs or a new atelier_contact_sheet_tests.rs) that seeds a real intake batch, calls export_contact_sheet, and asserts the real SVG + JSON receipt artifacts land in the ArtifactStore with content-hash validation and lineage back to the intake item IDs. 2) Run it against managed PG; record the pass + product_commit.
